# snipeit_hardware (Data Source)

Looks up a single asset by `id`, `asset_tag` or `serial`. Exactly one of these must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_hardware" "by_tag" {
  asset_tag = "IT-0001"
}

data "snipeit_hardware" "by_serial" {
  serial = "C02XXXXXXX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) Asset tag to look up.
- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the asset.
- `serial` (String) Serial number to look up.

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the owning company.
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the default location.
- `model_id` (Number) Id of the asset model.
- `name` (String) Display name of the asset.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `purchase_cost` (String) Purchase cost as a plain decimal string.
- `purchase_date` (String) Purchase date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `status_id` (Number) Id of the status label.
